prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed portrait front-cover illustration for an educational book, Foundations of Generative Artificial Intelligence, by Marco Cremaschi.
Primary request: create a sophisticated, memorable editorial illustration of language becoming a structured generative system. Do not include any text; the book typography will be typeset separately.
Scene/backdrop: nearly black blue-green background, matte and subtle, extending to all edges.
Subject: an elegant sculptural stream made of many very thin layered paper-like ribbons and small rectangular token-like fragments. Sparse separated fragments on the left gradually align into a coherent flowing folded form on the right, suggesting structure and emergence from language. The form has a clear architectural rhythm, translucent pale-cyan edges and warm-white planes, carefully lit and detailed, with deep dimensional shadows. It should feel like a premium contemporary science book, calm, intellectual, tactile and precise.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3. Keep the upper 45 percent of the entire image almost empty and uniformly very dark for a large white book title. Concentrate the sculptural form in the lower half, spanning nearly the full width around 58 to 85 percent of the image height, with generous breathing room. Keep the bottom 10 percent dark and quiet for author and subtitle.
Lighting/mood: controlled studio light, restrained cyan rim light, beautiful crisp folds, fine material texture, high contrast.
Color palette: charcoal navy and deep blue-green, cyan matching #53EAFD, and soft warm white, consistent with the existing book.
Constraints: finished flat cover artwork, no book mockup, no perspective view of a book, no lettering, no readable or pseudo text, no logos, no watermark.
Avoid: robot heads, brains, circuit boards, globes, sci-fi holograms, neon haze, stock AI imagery, chaotic particles, overcomplex background.
